⚡ Your energy bill goes up AGAIN from 1 October.

Ofgem has confirmed the price cap rises 4% — from £1,663 to £1,723 for a typical household — because of high international gas prices. The VAT cut on electricity helps, but it expires in March.

A country with gas under its own seabed shouldn't be at the mercy of world prices every winter. 👇
